To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a high CAV-1 protein expression level predicts a poor prognosis for patients with clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
caveolin-1 protein expression in the tumour cytoplasm of clear cell renal cell carcinoma (RCC) predicts a poor survival.
a higher than average expression of caveolin 1 in tumor cells cytoplasm is a poor prognostic factor for clear cell renal cell carcinoma patients.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method for the detection of a single-cell cell.
the development of new diagnostic and prognostically relevant molecular markers for renal cell cancer.
the identification of new prognostic markers for RCC and the understanding of the molecular pathogenesis of this tumor.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CAV1 is a prognostic biomarker in RCC.
caveolin-1 protein expression in the cytoplasm of clear cell RCC cells is a poor prognostic factor.
caveolae play an important role not only in the development of RCC, but also in the progression of the disease.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CAV1 may be a promising marker in RCC.
CAV1 is a potential prognostic marker for RCC and that CAV1 could be a useful target for therapy in RCC.
CAV1 is an independent predictor of poor outcome in clear cell RCC and may serve as a prognostic marker for this tumor entity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CAV1 may be a useful prognos-tic marker and may be a useful target for therapy of clear cell RCC.
CAV1 protein over-expression is associated with a worse prognosis in clear cell renal cell cancer.
CAV1 expression can be used to predict the survival of RCC patients.
